Name: Epic Arsenal
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]My brother loves Stardew and pixel art, and he had this idea, so I wanted to help him turn it into a mod. He plans to redesign all the weapons in the game, including the ones sold by the villagers at the Desert Festival.

The new update is out, and clubs are finished. I will add more variations in other updates! He is drawing the tools and is thinking about editing the weapons from other mod expansions too.

You can edit the config inside the mod folder to disable or enable weapons or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit them in game.

Comment if you like it :D

Credits:
CatDev for the weapon textures.[/size]
[size=3]ConcernedApe for the vanilla weapons.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] for making this mod possible![/size]
